description: This source file implements utility functions for feature support detection in ANGLE, including parsing rules from JSON, system info management, and decision logic for whether to use ANGLE based on application and device scenarios.

classes.name: StringPart
classes.description: Encapsulates a string with optional wildcard matching.

classes.name: IntegerPart
classes.description: Encapsulates a 32-bit unsigned integer with optional wildcard matching.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Represents a version with major, minor, subminor, and patch components, supporting wildcard matching and JSON creation.

classes.name: Application
classes.description: Represents an application with a name and optional version, supporting JSON creation and matching.

classes.name: GPU
classes.description: Represents a GPU with vendor, device ID, and version, supporting JSON creation and matching.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device with manufacturer, model, and associated GPUs, supporting JSON creation and matching.

classes.name: Scenario
classes.description: Represents a specific scenario combining application and device for rule matching.

classes.name: Rule
classes.description: Defines a rule with application and device criteria and an ANGLE usage decision.

classes.name: RuleList
classes.description: Holds a list of rules, supports parsing from JSON, and determines ANGLE usage for scenarios.

methods.name: CreateVersionFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Version object from JSON data.

methods.name: CreateApplicationFromJson
methods.description: Creates an Application object from JSON data.

methods.name: CreateGpuFromJson
methods.description: Creates a GPU object from JSON data.

methods.name: CreateDeviceFromJson
methods.description: Creates a Device object from JSON data.

methods.name: ReadRulesFromJsonString
methods.description: Parses rules from a JSON string and returns a RuleList object.

methods.name: getUseANGLE
methods.description: Determines whether ANGLE should be used for a given scenario based on rules.
